Anna (Docs): Quick heads-up — docs site deploy window moved to 17:00 PST today (maintenance). Please freeze non-critical content by 16:00 PST.
Raj (SDK): Copy. Will the SDK docs regen still run after cutoff?
Anna (Docs): Yes, plan is: regen in staging at ~16:10, manual smoke, then promote to prod at 17:00 if green.
Maria (Product): Changelog PR #482 is ready — includes the version bump to 2.3.1. Needs one more review.
Simon (Infra): I can do the version bump + smoke tests. Ping me 15m before regen.
Lin (Release): @Simon you're owner for the release docs side. I'll coordinate release notes publish after prod deploy.
Raj (SDK): Heads up — my local SDK docs regen fails on M1 with a tsc error, blocking the CI job:
```
error TS7022: Definition file name '/usr/local/lib/node_modules/typescript/lib/lib.dom.d.ts' must end with '.d.ts'
```
Any tips?
Anna (Docs): Try running with node 18 and npm ci, we saw a flaky typescript mismatch earlier. Also the regen CI uses node 18.
Raj (SDK): Trying node 18 now...
deploy-bot: docs-staging CI started for branch release/2.3.x — https://ci.redwood.ai/build/9876 :rocket:
Simon (Infra): I pushed a tiny changelog fix to PR #482 (formatting). Can someone approve?
Maria (Product): Approving now. :white_check_mark:
Raj (SDK): Node 18 fixed the local tsc issue, regen completed locally. Pushing doc artifacts to staging.
Anna (Docs): Great. Simon — when you run the smoke tests can you check the quickstart snippet on the landing page? It sometimes loads the old bundle.
Simon (Infra): Yep will do. Planning smoke run 16:30 PST.
Lin (Release): Reminder: cutoff for code/infra changes is 16:00 PST. Only release-critical fixes after that.
Anna (Docs): After smoke pass we'll queue the prod promotion. If anything fails we roll back to the prior docs snapshot and Lin will open postmortem.
Raj (SDK): One more thing — SDK docs regen script has a new flag `--skip-types` to speed up CI. Do we want to enable it for this run?
Anna (Docs): Not this time, keep full regen to catch any surface changes.
deploy-bot: docs-staging CI passed — artifacts available: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/9876/logs
Simon (Infra): Smoke tests good for quickstart and API reference. Ready for prod.
Anna (Docs): Promo scheduled for 17:00 PST. I'll post a final go/no-go 10m before.
Maria (Product): Thanks everyone. I updated the release checklist and tagged the changelog entry.
Lin (Release): All set on my end. Ping me if rollback needed. :handshake:
Anna (Docs): Go/no-go in 10.
